data.one_liner: A widget that wraps buttons and disables taps while the tap callback is in progress.
data.what_it_does: TapDebounce disables button taps automatically while an asynchronous callback is executing. It prevents accidental double-taps and allows configuring a cooldown duration or custom busy UI states.
use_when: You want to prevent users from rapidly tapping buttons multiple times
You need to disable navigation pop buttons during asynchronous operations
avoid_when: You need global state management instead of widget-level debouncing
strengths: Supports custom cooldown durations and exception handling
Provides builder callbacks to alter widget appearance during busy states
weaknesses: Limited to tap debouncing on a per-widget basis
